translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 1 Yaaya
book.title: 1 Yaaya Maktumne ta awalle taat Yaaya siirtu

content: Gem kol kooginay, nu siiraakoŋ gamin-aŋ a kuu un̰jenno ɗo zunuubinnar. Kar gay, ya waan gin zunuubinna, gi gin gem kaak yaate male ɗo uŋji ka Tatte Buŋ. Ŋaar ko Iisa Masi kaak gina ay maan iŋ botiliy.
Ŋaar ber ziy satkine a Buŋ yaate saamiyin̰ zunuubinnite. Buŋ gay, ŋaar saamiyaatenno zunuubinnite kunten di, kar gay, ŋaa saamiye oki ku gee ku duniiner okin̰co.
Gem kaak ibingig Buŋ, ŋaar cokiya kaawoy
Ya gi karmiyaat kaaw ta Buŋdi, ansi-ak gaara kadar ka seener gi ibingig Buŋ.
Ya gem ɗiya a ŋa ibingig Buŋ ho ŋa karmiygitɗo kaawoy, ŋaar-ak, ŋa raada ho ŋa ginno seene.
Kar gem kaak karmiyaat kaaw ta Buŋdi gay, ŋaar elgig Buŋ min ɗo gelbiney. Pa-ak, gi iban tak kadar ginte iŋ Buŋ, gi n̰um rakki.
Ya gem kat ɗiya a ŋa n̰um iŋ Buŋ, ŋaa goye ar kaak Iisa goytu.
Gem kol roynay, kaaw taat nu kaawiiko-an, taar kaawɗo taat marbinto, kar gay, ta taar ko taat min awalle ŋu kaawiiko-at di. Kaaw-at, taar sawa di iŋ taat ku dortu-ata.
Kar gay, kaaw taat nu siiriiko-an, taar marbinto. Goyin̰ji ka Iisa, ŋaar gaara kadar kaaw-an taar seene ho goyiŋko kaŋko sa gaaraw. Asaan gondikaw sa sawlaw, ho portikaw ta seener sa been̰a
ko.
Gem kaak ɗiya a ŋa goy ɗo portikaw, kar ŋa ello een̰ji, ŋaar-ak goy misa ɗo gondikor.
Kar gay, ya gem kaak elgig siŋji, ŋaar goy ɗo portikaw ho maan ginno ɗo gelbiney kaak yaa n̰aamin̰ ɗo nigindi.
Kar gem kaak ƴila siŋji gay, ŋaar goy misa ɗo gondikor. Ŋa jaawa ɗo gondikor-ata ho ŋa ibanno wer ka ŋa ɓaayiyo, asaan iŋ gondikaw-at, ŋa ar noolo.
Diye ka kaar ɗo gamin ku duniiner
Gem kol kooginay, nu siiraakoŋ gamin-aŋ, asaan Buŋ saamiykoŋ ko zunuubinniko iŋ siŋ ku Iisa Masi.
Kuŋ aginiydu, nu siiraakoŋ gamin-aŋ, asaan ku ibingig ŋaar kaak min ɗo teese ka duniiner di, ŋaar goy ko. Kuŋ ɗubal iŋ gemsa oki, nu siiraako, asaan ku begirji ɗo *Seetanner.

Gem kol kooginay, nu siirko pey, asaan ku ibingig Tatte Buŋ. Kuŋ aginiydu, nu siirko, asaan ku ibingig gem kaak min ɗo teese ka duniiner di, ŋaar goy ko. Kuŋ ɗubal iŋ gemsa, nu siirko, asaan ku goy bombo, ku icit kaaw ta Buŋdi ɗo gelbinko ho ku begirji ɗo Seetanner.
Dakoŋ diyenno kaƴko ɗo gamin ku duniiner ho dakoŋ elguwin̰coɗo. Ya gem kaak el gamin ku duniiner, ibinoŋ kadar ŋa elgigɗo Tatte Buŋ.

Gamin ku duniiner gay, ŋuur ko : ele ka gamnar, diye ka kaar ɗo gamin kuuk gee taliyo, ho ice ka ziŋkar ɗo gamin kuuk gee giniyo. Gamin ŋuur-aŋ, okin̰co, ŋuur ku duniiner di, ŋuur asɗo min ɗo Tatte Buŋ.
Ibinoŋ kadar duniin-an, taar gaasa ko ho gamin okin̰co kuuk gee elgiy sa rawta ko. Kar ya gem gina taat Buŋ rakiy gay, ŋaa gase goye ka gaasɗo.
Adiney ka Iisa
Gem kol kooginay, ɗak sooɗ di, duniin yaa gaase. Ku dor kadar adiney ka Iisa yaa ase. Ka seener gay, adiney dakin as ko. Asin̰co-aŋ gaara kadar duniin gaasa ko.
Adiney-aŋ, min awalle ŋu goy iŋ ginte, kar gay, gi sawaɗo, ho paa ko, ŋu amiltu minninte. Zer, ya gi sawa, nec ŋuu goye iŋ ginte. Maanna-aŋ gaara kadar ka seener, ŋu iŋ gintenno.
Kuŋ gay, Iisa Masi berko Ruwwiney. Ansii ko, okiŋko, ku ibiniit seene.
Nu balko siire a ku ibingitɗo misa seene. Kar gay, ku ibingit ko ho ku iban kadar min seen ta Buŋdi, ginno maan ka raadiner atta.
Ansi-ak, waa kaak raadaw ? Illa ŋa gem kaak ɗiya a Iisa, ŋaar Masiɗo kaak Buŋ n̰aamtu. Gem ŋaar-ak di raadaw. Gem kaak poocig Tatte Buŋ ho iŋ Roŋji, ŋaar-ak ko adiney ka Iisa Masi.
Ya gem kaak poocig Roŋji ka Buŋdi, ŋa poocig Tacco Buŋ oki. Kar gay, ya gem kaak ooyig Roŋji, ŋa ibingig Tacco Buŋ oki.
Kuŋ gay zeeɗoŋ a kaawin kuuk ku dortu min awalle yaa goye ɗo gelbinko. Ya gamin-aŋ goy ko pa-ak, kuŋko oki, gelbinko yaa gine rakki iŋ Tacco Buŋ ho iŋ Roŋji.
Iisa Masi, ŋaar ɗiy a ŋaate bere goye ka gaasɗo.
Nu siirkoŋ gamin-aŋ ɗo bi ka gee kuuk asaako geciŋko kuu rawte.

Kuŋ gay, Ruwwin taat Iisa Masi beriiko, taar goy iŋ kuŋko. Ɗo saan taar-an, ku ƴokaaɗo pey gem ka pey kat asaako ɓildiŋko, asaan Ruwwin taar gaaraakoŋ ko gamin okin̰co. Gamin kuuk ta gaariiko-aŋ gay, ŋuur ka seener di. Raadin rakki sa, ŋu bal gine. Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak, icon kaaw taat Iisa Masi gaariiko ho goyoŋ iŋ gelbin rakki iŋ ŋaara.
Gem kol kooginay, diŋ gay, goyoŋ iŋ gelbin rakki iŋ Iisa Masi a ƴiriy taat ŋaa yeepe, gii goye bombo ho sokan̰ rakki sa diyaatenno ɗo uŋji.
Ku iban kadar Iisa Masi gin ay maan iŋ botiliy. Paa ko, kuu ibine oki kadar gem kaak gina maan kaak iŋ botiliy, ŋaar oki roŋ ka Buŋdi.
